note: Written by game_settings.py for the editor's Game Studio. Don't edit by hand.

sections.title: HERO ARCADE: the click-to-shoot game in the neon homepage header

help.game.hitRadius: how forgiving aiming is (1 = you must hit the target exactly)
help.game.comboWindow: time you have to land the next hit to keep a combo going
help.game.baseSpawnEvery: time between new targets at level 1 (gets shorter each level)
help.game.pointsPerLevel: score needed to go up a level
help.game.targetOpacity: how see-through the flying targets are (1 = solid)
help.game.shields: city shield hearts (they recharge when they run out: the game never ends by itself)
help.game.bossEvery: a mothership boss appears every this many points
help.game.powerSeconds: how long Rapid Fire / Spread Shot / Slow-mo last (seconds)
help.game.maxTargets: most flying targets on screen at level 1...
help.game.moreTargetsPerLevel: ...plus this many more for each level (level 3 = 6 + 3x2 = 12)
help.game.targetsDuringBoss: most flying targets while a mothership boss is out
help.weapons: cooldown = time between shots, boss = damage to bosses and giants per hit
help.monsters: the giant robot and kaiju that wreck the city
help.monsters.firstAfter: after the first shot, the first giant arrives this much later
help.monsters.attractAfter: before anyone plays, one stomps in after this long (just a show)
help.monsters.attractSmashes: ...and walks off after this many blows
help.monsters.every: time between giants (after one is beaten)
help.monsters.height: how tall, as a share of the screen height
help.monsters.smashEvery: time between blows on a building
help.monsters.buildingsPerShield: every this many flattened buildings costs a shield
help.monsters.atOnce: most giants in the city at the same time...
help.letters.backAfter: how long until a shot letter spins back in
help.beast_points: score for blowing up the dragon or the phoenix

sections.title: SKY BEASTS: the particle dragon and phoenix over the header

help.dragonSegments: how long the dragon is (body pieces)
help.dragonThickness: body radius at its thickest, in pixels
help.dragonSpeed: how fast they fly their loop
help.followMouse: how strongly they drift towards the mouse (0 = not at all)
help.dragonHealth: damage before it explodes (a laser hit does 1, a rocket 6)
help.respawnSeconds: time until an exploded beast re-forms (seconds)

sections.title: NEON GRID: the animated floor behind the header

help.columns: tiles to each side of the middle
help.rows: how far into the distance the floor goes
help.glideSpeed: tiles per second (negative = slides away into the horizon)
help.pulseSpeed: how fast tiles grow and shrink
help.horizon: where the horizon sits (0.40 = 40% down the screen)
help.hueNear: colours by distance (hue 0-360; 270 purple, 320 pink, 385 orange)

sections.title: STATION DEFENSE: the space strategy game

help.supply_cap: ships you can have before building Supply Depots
help.waves: seconds until the first alien wave, then between waves
help.crystal: crystals per field, per trip, time to mine
help.enemies.start: aliens guarding the hive when the game starts
help.enemies.maxAlive: waves stop adding aliens once this many are alive (keeps it smooth)
help.zoom.start: how close the camera starts (1 = the old, far view; bigger = bigger ships)
help.zoom.max: the closest you can zoom in (wheel, + / - keys, the + - buttons, pinch)
help.build.radius: you can build this far from the station or an outpost (chain outposts to expand)
help.build.supplyMax: the most ships Supply Depots can raise your fleet to

help.light: how far the hero's light reaches (tiles)
help.heroSprite: show the pre-rendered Female Angel Hero with its animations (False = use the 3D model in the arpg.hero slot)
help.hollowSprite: show the animated Corrupted Astral Sorcerer as the Hollow (False = use the arpg.hollow 3D model)
help.golemSprite: show the animated Green Elemental as the Golem (False = use the arpg.golem 3D model)
help.elfSprite: show the animated Evil Green Elf (False = use the arpg.elf 3D model)
help.wizardSprite: show the fully animated Evil Wizard (False = use the arpg.wizard 3D model)
help.skitterSprite: show the detailed lava spider as the Skitter (False = use the arpg.skitter 3D model)
help.hero: walking speed, sword reach (tiles), time between swings
help.enemies.perRoomMax: most monsters in a room on floor 1...
help.enemies.extraMax: ...but never more than this many extra
help.enemies.bossEvery: a Warden boss guards the stairs every this many floors (0 = never)
help.enemies.golemFromFloor: the Golem (Green Elemental) shows up from this floor on (1 = from the start)
help.rarity: loot: chance of each rarity, and how much stronger it is

sections.title: QUEST: the XP you get for exploring the site (every page)

help.stage: XP for each section you reach
help.area: XP for each page you discover
help.areaComplete: bonus for clearing every section on a page
help.quest: XP for sending the contact form
